description.en: A single-row deep-groove ball bearing, 5 mm bore × 16 mm outside diameter × 5 mm wide. Its outer ring seats in a housing bore; a 5 mm shaft passes through its inner ring. A Voron 2.4-class Z drive carries its output shaft on three of them.
description.es: Un rodamiento rígido de bolas de una hilera, de 5 mm de barreno × 16 mm de diámetro exterior × 5 mm de ancho. Su anillo exterior asienta en un alojamiento; por su anillo interior pasa una flecha de 5 mm. Un accionamiento Z de clase Voron 2.4 apoya su flecha de salida en tres de ellos.
description.fr: Un roulement rigide à une rangée de billes, alésage 5 mm × diamètre extérieur 16 mm × largeur 5 mm. Sa bague extérieure se loge dans un alésage de logement ; un arbre de 5 mm traverse sa bague intérieure. Un entraînement Z de classe Voron 2.4 porte son arbre de sortie sur trois d'entre eux.
description.pt: Um rolamento rígido de uma carreira de esferas, furo de 5 mm × diâmetro exterior de 16 mm × 5 mm de largura. O anel exterior assenta num alojamento; um eixo de 5 mm passa pelo anel interior. Um acionamento Z de classe Voron 2.4 apoia o eixo de saída em três deles.

sources.title: SKF 625-2RS1 miniature deep groove ball bearing (distributor listing, Quality Bearings Online)

sources.supports: p. 8 (Hardware reference): the 625 bearing is used on the Voron Z drives; p. 33 (Z Drives and Idlers, belt drive assembly): three 625 bearings on the 5x60 shaft

sources.title: POWGE / Gates Voron 2.4 motion set (retailer listing, West3D)
sources.supports: Voron 2.4 motion set: GT2 open belt LL-2GT-9 (9 mm wide, Gates); GT2 belt loop 6 mm wide, 188 mm, 4 pcs (Gates); GT2 16T pulley, 5 mm bore, 4 pcs; GT2 20T pulley 9 mm wide, 5 mm bore, 4 pcs; GT2 80T pulley 6 mm wide, 5 mm bore, 4 pcs; 625 2RS bearings, 12 pcs; 5 × 60 mm shaft with ground flat, 4 pcs

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of side face A, on the bearing axis. +z runs along the axis through the bearing to side face B at z = 5. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the bearing is round, so both interfaces have continuous symmetry.

interfaces.note: Male: the bearing goes into its housing bore. As bearing-608: the normal runs from face A toward face B, the side the housing lies on, so a seat framed at its entrance (normal out of the cavity) takes face B first and leaves face A flush with the entrance.
Female: a 5 mm shaft passes through the inner ring. Framed at face B (z = 5), normal +z out of that face, as bearing-608's bore; shaft-5mm's journals are framed where face B lands.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-ZBED lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A shielded (2Z) or sealed (2RS) 625 has the same boundary dimensions. The fit of the host's bore is the host's design choice.
